M14 BR.description: The last battle rifle issued to the Grand Federation military, it was replaced by the M16A1. It still sees limited service in the military with variants developed into sniper systems, and has been modernised into the MK14 EBR. Loads from a 20 round magazine, with notoriously high recoil, to the point where future models ditched the select fire switch.
M14 BR.name: M14 BR

HK417.description:
An Eisenmarkian battle rifle incorporating the designs of the AR-10 and M416 featuring a proprietary receiver and ambidextrous controls, famous for its worldwide use by police forces.
Packs a punch throughout distance with moderate firerate but makes recoil control and reloads difficult with its bulky ergonomics.
Switch to semi for improved accuracy!

Model submitted by Rialag.
HK417.name: HK417

SCAR UL.description:
A bullpup variant of the civilian MK17 variant that is slightly lighter, modified with a binary trigger grouping.
The binary trigger makes it that a round is fired when the trigger is pulled and another one when it is released.

Model submitted by Mysterious Modeler X.
SCAR UL.name: SCAR UL

BOOMBOX.description:
A Grand Federation Rifle chambered in 8.6 Blackout, meant to take down beasts of any kind no matter the size.
Excellent damage across all ranges with average fire rate while remaining very light weight but suffers from subsonic bullet speed.
Where's the Kaboom? I was promised an Earth-shattering Kaboom!

Modeled by Rialag and Vic.
BOOMBOX.name: BOOMBOX

IA2 BR.description:
A Selvazian 7.62x51mm NATO battle rifle variant of the IA2, designed by IMBEL as a replacement for the FN FAL in Selvazian military service.

Above average damage performance, but poor reload times and somewhat inconsistent recoil.
IA2 BR.name: IA2 BR

SCAR-H.description:
A Belvaunian rifle, favored by SOCOM. Stable, jack of all trades battle rifle. 

Model submitted by Mysterious Modeler X.
SCAR-H.name: SCAR-H

BEOWULF ECR.description:
A fully-automatic rifle in 12.7x42mm based on a heavily customized AR-15 platform.

Extremely powerful up close, but has a very limited magazine capacity and lacks accuracy at longer ranges.
BEOWULF ECR.name: BEOWULF ECR

HCAR.description: The HCAR, acronym for Heavy Counter-Assault Rifle, is the revision of a classic with new furniture. Intended for the civilian markets, it was made with Semi-Automatic fire only, but we are sure that the good fellas at R&D can put some Betty Boop and give you the extra firepower you might know the HCAR's old man for...if you put in the hours, that is. They only understand violence. So we show them violence. They have heavy caliber infantry, so we have those too. You think we fight this war with sticks and stones?
HCAR.name: HCAR

RM277.description:
One of the entrants to the NGSW programme. The RM277 possesses a unique firemode arrangement that functions a lot like the M1918 BAR and allows it to switch between high rpm with high recoil, and low rpm with low recoil.
The specialized 6.8mm TVCM ammo this gun uses is relatively poor up close due to overpenetration characteristics. Best used at mid-range.

Model submitted by Rialag.
RM277.name: RM277
